description: Source code for runtime variable argument functions in PyTorch JIT, including formatting, einsum, tuple/list construction, object creation, type checking, and dequantization.

methods.name: addFormattedArg
methods.description: Formats an argument based on a format specifier and appends it to a stringstream.

methods.name: tupleUnpack
methods.description: Unpacks a tuple from the stack and pushes its elements onto the stack.

methods.name: einsum
methods.description: Performs Einstein summation notation on tensors.

methods.name: listUnpack
methods.description: Unpacks a list from the stack into individual elements.

methods.name: tupleConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a tuple from stack elements.

methods.name: namedTupleConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a named tuple with a specified type.

methods.name: listConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a list from stack elements.

methods.name: dictConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary from key-value pairs on the stack.

methods.name: createObject
methods.description: Creates a new object of a specified class type.

methods.name: isinstance
methods.description: Checks if the top of the stack is an instance of any of the given types.

methods.name: tupleSlice
methods.description: Slices a tuple from the stack.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Dequantizes tensors or tensor lists within a tuple.
